name: Worm
author: Wildbow
review: A fun read with one of the most interesting protagonists I've read in a while. Very intersting world-building in a very unique setting. I would reccomend it to anyone that wants to try reading about superheroes.

name: Way of Kings
author: Brandon Sanderson
review: The start of the Stormlight Archive and a soft introduction to the Cosmere. I personally enjoy the slow world-building that is Brandon Sanderson's specialty.

name: Words of Radiance
review: I'm probably biased because Shallan is my favorite character, but I think this book is my favorite in the Stormlight Archive. It had the perfect balance of character, plot, and world-building that I really enjoyed.
author: Brandon Sanderson

name: Oathbringer
author: Brandon Sanderson
review: While I overall enjoyed it, I think the character development for Kaladin and Shallan was sidelined a bit. Also, I didn't really enjoy the ending as it felt too `Avengers`-esque for my taste. I still think it's a good book, especially for Dalinar's character development, but I think it didn't live up to the earlier books.

name: Rhythm of War
author: Brandon Sanderson
review: While a majority of the book, especially Kaladin's perspective, takes place in a tower, I really enjoyed it for some reason. Although I really disliked Venli's perspective, which frankly just made some parts a slog for me

name: Wind and Truth
author: Brandon Sanderson
review: The final book of the Stormlight Archive, I know that online there is a very mixed reception to this book. I personally enjoyed it, but I can understand where some of the criticism comes from. The 10 days format, while interesting, felt a bit limiting at times.
